items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: His name was Moohah, and Joe honored him by naming a song after him.

ctx.x: Can you believe that? There’s a guy, a disk jockey, from his hometown, Memphis, Tennessee. His name was Moohah, and Joe honored him by naming a song after him. Moohah the D.J. Now remember, I was having all these problems with Joe on the road, right? But we went home, to his hometown. He lived not too far from where Elvis was born and raised in the area – where Elvis was raised.
